article.headline: Brown's 23 lead Fairleigh Dickinson past Stonehill 82-69
article.description: — Terrence Brown's 23 points helped Fairleigh Dickinson defeat Stonehill 82-69 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Brown's 23 lead Fairleigh Dickinson past Stonehill 82-69
article.story: HACKENSACK, N.J. -- — Terrence Brown's 23 points helped Fairleigh Dickinson defeat Stonehill 82-69 on Thursday night. Brown added five assists and three steals for the Knights (12-18, 8-7 Northeast Conference). Dylan Jones scored 17 points while going 5 of 8 from the floor, including 4 for 7 from 3-point range, and 3 for 3 from the line. Jameel Morris had nine points and went 4 of 7 from the field. The Skyhawks (14-16, 6-9) were led by Louie Semona, who posted 24 points and nine rebounds. Hermann Koffi added 16 points for Stonehill. Chas Stinson also recorded 12 points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
